answer: Three leasing companies pass lease equity to the customer: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co. Lease equity is the amount by which our offer exceeds the lease buyout. Bluewater Leasing doesn't pay it to the customer. It applies the equity to a car bought from Northwind. Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all. Since February 1, 2026, Apex Lease Co has added a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount. That fee raises the buyout, so the customer's equity is smaller.
